jobs.title: Manager/Lead, Cortex GTM Strategy & Ops
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
Job Summary

The Team
The Next-Generation Security (NGS) business is a primary growth engine for Palo Alto Networks, driving $9B+ ARR and growing rapidly at 60% Y/Y. Within NGS, our Cortex & Cloud Security portfolio offers market-leading solutions across SOC Automation, AI-driven Security, and Endpoint Protection. This role sits within the Cortex Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, specifically focused on scaling the pre-sales GTM strategy, channel partner activation, and ecosystem expansion for our AI & Endpoint Security (XDR / AES) business units. The person in this role will report to Sr. Director, Cortex GTM.

Your career
We are looking for a strategy team member to design the strategy and architect the pre-sales and partner GTM programs required to scale our AI and Endpoint Security businesses.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining multi-year GTM roadmaps, designing scalable partner-led sales motions (including cross-sell/upsell programs and competitive displacement initiatives), and operationalizing global GTM frameworks. You will balance high-level strategic problem-solving with rigorous analytical modeling and hands-on execution across global theaters (AMER, EMEA, JAPAC, LATAM). If you are a former management consultant or tech strategy/ops lead looking to flex your strategic muscles, drive high-impact channel transformations, and directly influence top-line growth in a fast-paced software environment, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities & Your Impact

- Define the 3-Year Partner Ambition: Lead the creation of the multi-year GTM roadmap to scale partner-sourced and partner-led revenues across AI and Endpoint Security domains.
- Ecosystem Architecture: Design and refine partner coverage models, tiering incentives, discount/margin structures, and co-selling frameworks across Distributors, National Resellers, GSIs, and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs).
- Sales Plays & Motion Design: Architect programmatic sales plays (e.g., net-new logo acquisition, competitive EDR takeouts, and fast-landing entry plays like AES/XDR soft-bundling).
- Pre-Sales & Systems Engineering Scaling: Partner with Regional Technical Directors and Channel SE leads to design pre-sales enablement programs, certification tracks, and hands-on laboratory workshops (e.g., Ultimate Test Drives, Capture the Flag).

- Rigorous Analytical Modeling: Conduct deep-dive market sizing, pipeline coverage analyses, and discount/margin impact studies using Salesforce, Tableau, and data platforms.
- Cadence & Governance: Establish global operating rhythms—including bi-weekly operational reviews, QBRs with executive sponsors, and quarterly deal registration audits—to maintain pipeline momentum and resolve deal-logging gaps.
- Theater Alignment: Collaborate closely with Theater Ecosystem and Sales leaders, Ecosystem Programs team, Partner Development Managers (PDMs), and Channel Business Managers (CBMs) to iterate and scale the success of the GTM initiatives

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- 3+ years of relevant work experience (pre-MBA), or recent MBA graduates with up to 2 years of post-MBA experience in management consulting or top-tier tech strategy or “bizops” functions.
- MBA graduate from a top-tier B-school or similar academic credentials or “direct promote” in Consulting or equivalent military experience.
- GTM Strategy experience / projects in B2B software industry.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail, experience using reporting and analytics applications, e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, GCP.
- Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with minimal supervision.
- Prior experience in planning, designing, and implementing Sales Improvement solutions at a global scale.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here .

$150,300.00 - $243,100.00/yr
Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at   accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

As an Onboarding Customer Success Manager at Idira, you will own and drive the onboarding journey for a diverse portfolio of customers across the ANZ region. Your primary goal is accelerating customers’ time-to-value by establishing measurable success criteria, proactively managing their onboarding milestones, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless start to their cybersecurity journey. Your efforts will cultivate adoption, drive satisfaction, and lay a strong foundation for future growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Onboarding Journey: Lead customers through a structured, milestone-driven onboarding process, ensuring they understand the Idira solution, its value, and the path to success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Sales Engineering, Customer Success Executives, and Renewals to provide consistent and coordinated onboarding experience.
Customer Goal Alignment: Work collaboratively with customers to define, document, and translate their business objectives into clear, actionable onboarding milestones.

Roles & Responsibilities
- Identify and assign key customer champions, admins, and end-users critical to onboarding success and product adoption.

- Risk and Escalation Management: Develop and communicate an escalation framework early onboarding to address potential issues or blockers swiftly.

- Identify Gaps Early: Proactively detect potential roadblocks or readiness gaps and mobilize Idira internal resources to drive resolution.

- Regular Progress Reviews: Conduct scheduled check-ins (monthly/bi-monthly) to monitor onboarding progress, address concerns, and ensure timely value realization.

- Advocate Enablement: Recommend and support customers in leveraging Idira enablement tools such as training programs, community forums, and documentation for self-service learning.

- Continuous Improvement: Gather customer feedback and contribute insights to enhance the onboarding process and overall customer experience.

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Onboarding, Implementation, or a related role within SaaS or technology companies.

- Demonstrated project management skills or familiarity managing complex onboarding projects.

- Passionate about customer satisfaction with a strong, proactive problem-solving mindset.

Chronosphere empowers customers to focus on the data and insights that matter by reducing complexity, optimizing costs, and remediating issues faster. Chronosphere reduces data volumes and associated costs by 84% on average while saving developers thousands of hours.  Recognized as a leader by major analyst firms, Chronosphere is trusted by the world's most innovative brands, including DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.

About the role
The Customer Success Architect (CSA) acts as the post-sales leader for Chronosphere’s largest customers. They offer strategic and technical guidance to help customers unlock the full potential of their observability strategy and maximize the use and value of Chronosphere.
In this role, you’ll guide customers through the customer journey, helping them navigate challenges, identify new use cases, and mitigate risk. You’ll build deep partnerships (both internal and external), manage day-to-day interactions, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver exceptional outcomes. - Active certification in CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or CISA required.

- Deep working knowledge of ISO 27001/2, NIST SP 800-53, NIST CSF, SOC 2 Type II, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and enterprise risk frameworks.

- Proven track record of developing and managing risk management processes, including risk quantification and executive-level reporting.

The Sr Sales Enablement Operations Manager is a high-influence role designed for a process-driven strategist. You will not simply support the team; you will drive the engine of the department, identifying operational bottlenecks, accelerating sales rep productivity, and owning the operational execution that connects EMEA sales strategy directly to quota attainment and drives operational execution for our most critical regional events. You will ensure that every initiative we launch is audited for impact, aligned with global standards, and executed with operational excellence.

Your Impact

- End-to-End Program Operational Governance: Own the full operational lifecycle of all EMEA enablement initiatives, leading strategic project intake, resource orchestration, and cross-functional project management to ensure every program is delivered on time and at a high standard. You will serve as the operational engine for EMEA Sales Enablement, ensuring key revenue-driving initiatives are executed seamlessly to maximize field productivity and reduce rep ramp time. You will manage the execution roadmap, event logistics and post-program success validation to ensure initiatives achieve their defined KPIs, while explicitly delegating content design and facilitation to the respective Subject Matter Experts.

Your focus is on maintaining a high standard of project integrity, ensuring that every initiative is delivered on schedule and is directly mapped to the team’s strategic KPIs and ROI.
- Program Management: Support the development and manage the execution of flagship enablement programs that help to drive revenue across EMEA, including FLIGHT Sales Onboarding, Brilliant at the Basics and EBC Excellence.
- Global Liaison & Best Practice Synthesis: Serve as the primary point of connection between EMEA and the Global Enablement organization. You will ensure regional alignment with global vision while proactively "exporting" EMEA best practices to influence the global roadmap, ensuring our theater has a seat at the table for worldwide strategy.
- Strategic Event Ownership (SKO & DSM Summit): Executing revenue-critical regional enablement milestones (SKO/DSM Summit) to accelerate pipeline velocity and Q1/Q2 deal execution. This is not a logistical support role; you own the end-to-end strategic framework, budget ROI, and the alignment of event content with EMEA’s specific sales objectives.
- Executive Intelligence & Strategic Communications: Own the "Enablement Drum Beat." You will synthesize complex workstream updates into high-level executive summaries, MBRs, and board-level reporting, ensuring EMEA leadership has a clear, data-driven view of our progress against the strategy.

Qualifications

- Operational Leadership: Proven experience in a Sales Operations leadership or Strategic Enablement leadership role where you have managed complex portfolios.
- Process Engineering: A track record of identifying operational bottlenecks and implementing scalable solutions that improve team productivity.
- Stakeholder Influence: Experience acting as a liaison between regional and global teams, with the ability to negotiate priorities and share best practices across borders.
- Program Ownership: Experience owning large-scale, high-visibility projects (like SKO) from a strategic and budgetary perspective, rather than just a logistical one.
- Data & Executive Synthesis: Ability to navigate CRM data and translate it into a compelling "so-what" narrative for executive-level stakeholders, including detailed strategic data analysis showing correlation between enablement efforts and results.

- Improve existing Channel (Distributor/VAR) operations, including onboarding, helpdesks, and rebate processes, by leveraging automation.

- Serve as the singular point-of-contact for Ecosystems Operations, advising the SVP of Global Ecosystems and aligning with cross-functional teams.

- 15+ years of experience leading RTM strategy or operations within high-growth, complex environments.

- Deep expertise across GSI, Cloud Provider, and Distributor models with a focus on scaling $100M+ commercial partnerships.

- Demonstrated experience transforming, redesigning, or standing up new operational frameworks to drive efficiency and automation.

- Proven track record of architecting data-centric organizations, including auditing complex data sets and enforcing data governance.

- Ability to translate high-level GTM strategies into actionable capacity plans and KPIs, with understanding of SaaS and hardware business models.
